verdict.rationale: The evidence shows an official Drata MCP server and API that let external AI agents work with Drata through natural language. That is a server-side integration for outside agents, not an AI assistant built into the product, so it belongs to a different story and earns no credit here. Nothing in the pack documents an in-product assistant that users can hand tasks to, and a compliance SaaS could plausibly ship one, so the axis applies and the verdict is none.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
